attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the specified SSH ed25519 public key, locked its password, and enforced key-based SSH authentication cluster-wide via /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf (PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes). Verified functionally before and after a full node reboot: pubkey login succeeds, password login is rejected outright with no prompt. Completed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence protocol (boot_id and uptime_since changed, services and opsadmin config recovered intact).
